caption: A metal rake is dragged along a concrete path in the dark, and faint sparks flick from the tines.

sa.check: A concrete path in the dark.
A metal rake is dragged along the path.
Faint sparks flick from the tines.
The sparks are at the tines, where the metal meets the concrete.
The drag comes first and the sparks follow.

pc.expect: Sparks appear only where the tines scrape the concrete and only while the rake is moving; each flick is brief and gone; they stop when the rake lifts.
pc.fail: Sparks appear while the rake is lifted clear of the path; or continue after the rake has stopped; or a spark stays lit at one spot for the rest of the clip; or sparks come from the handle or the rake's back.

pc.expect: One rake with its tines; the sparks leave nothing behind on the path.
pc.fail: Glowing dots stay on the path after the rake has passed; or tines appear or vanish; or a second rake appears; or the rake vanishes.

pc.expect: The sparks flick out behind the tines, along the direction of the drag, and drop to the path.
pc.fail: Sparks fly ahead of the tines against the drag; or radiate equally in all directions; or climb steadily and stay aloft.

pc.expect: The rake is a rigid tool: the tines bend only slightly as they scrape and the handle stays straight.
pc.fail: The tines bend back like rubber and stay bent; or the handle bows or wobbles like a rope; or the concrete grooves or ripples under the tines.

pc.expect: The tines scrape the path's surface and stay above it; the rake passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The tines sink through the concrete; or the rake passes through a wall, kerb or plant; or the rake merges with the path; or the path surface opens.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The rake's colour, the path's surface and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The rake changes colour; or the path changes texture; or the surroundings rearrange.

note: Who or what drags the rake is not judged.
